name: Heo lang nuong
summary: Heo làng nướng is on the Vietnam Tourism rural portal’s weekend-market specialty list. Vietnam Tourism’s pork skewer, and thịt heo hun khói on the dried-food list, are different names. A price is Check on arrival.
